reader.description: The type of 'log reader' to use for retrieving log messages.

file_path.description: The path to the file the 'file' reader should read logs from.

file_match.description: The recording id of the recording the 'file' reader should seek to for playback.

es_baseurl.description: The base URL to request Elasticsearch through. Should not contain query or fragment parts.

es_query.description: The query string to send to Elasticsearch.

es_verbose.description: If true, enable verbose output on Elasticsearch HTTP client.

persist.description: If true, ignore any keyboard-generated signals and the quit key.

lax.description: If true, ignore missing (dropped, or lost) log messages.
